svg.text: Per-Seed Paired Population Differences: G7c (L1) and Fly-RSI L2 Finals
Seeds sorted by paired difference (mean late flies, ticks 10,100–20,000). Solid dark line: mean; blue band: 95% bootstrap CI (20,000 resamples); dashed orange: prespecified bar.

g.text: Note: G7c per-seed diffs stored at 0.1 resolution by solo.mjs.
